title: Sign in with your Baitong account
description: One sign-in unlocks every model in AionUi. No separate registration.
accountPlaceholder: Enter your Baitong account or email
keepSignedInBody: The session is restored after closing the app or rebooting, so the password is normally asked only once.
credentialNote: The password is encrypted and stored on this computer; it is removed when you sign out or switch accounts. Chats and files stay with each account.

errors.accountRequired: Enter your Baitong account or email
errors.invalidCredentials: Baitong rejected this account or password
errors.networkError: Cannot reach the Baitong service. Check the intranet connection and try again
errors.adapterUnavailable: The local Baitong adapter is unavailable. Try again shortly
errors.credentialsRequired: Stored credentials cannot be used. Enter the password again
